question: If 8 + 2px<sup>2</sup> - 36x - 27x<sup>3</sup> = (2 - 3x)<sup>3</sup>, then what is the value of p?
question_hi: यदि 8 + 2px2 - 36x - 27x3 = (2 - 3x)3, तो p का मान क्या है?
solution:
Given:

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x3 = (2 – 3x)3

Formula used:

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

Calculation:

(2 – 3x)3 

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

(2)3 – (3x)3 – 3 × 2 × 3x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x3 – 18x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x3 – 36x + 54x2

Comparison the coefficient of both the equation, we get

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x3 = 8 – 27x3 – 36x + 54x2

⇒ 2px2 = 54x2

⇒ 2p = 54

⇒ p = (54/2)

⇒ p = 27

∴ The required value of p is 27
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x3 = (2 – 3x)3

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

गणना:

(2 – 3x)3 

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

(2)3 – (3x)3 – 3 × 2 × 3x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x3 – 18x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x3 – 36x + 54x2

दोनों समीकरणों के गुणांक की तुलना करने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x3 = 8 – 27x3 – 36x + 54x2

⇒ 2px2 = 54x2

⇒ 2p = 54

⇒  p = (54/2)

⇒ p = 27

∴ p का अभीष्ट मान 27 है

question: The area of a square shaped field is 1764 m2. The breadth of a rectangular park is \(\frac{1}{6}\)th of the side of the square field and the length is four times its breadth. What is the cost (in Rs.) of levelling the park at Rs. 30 per m2?
question_hi: एक वर्गाकार खेत का क्षेत्रफल 1764 मीटर2 है। एक आयताकार पार्क की चौड़ाई वर्गाकार खेत की भुजा का \(\frac{1}{6}\)वां भाग है और लंबाई उसकी चौड़ाई की चार गुनी है। 30 रुपये प्रति मीटर2 की दर से पार्क को समतल करने की लागत (रुपये में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:

The area of a square shaped field = 1764 m2

Formula used:

Area of square = (side)2

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

Calculation:

The area of a square shaped field = 1764 m2

Side of square field = √1764 = 42 m

Breadth of rectangle field = (42 × 1/6) = 7 m

Length of rectangle field = (7 × 4) = 28 m

Area of rectangular field = (28 × 7) m2 = 196 m2

Cost of leveling the park = Rs. (196 × 30)

⇒ Rs. 5880

So, the required cost of leveling the park is 5880
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

एक वर्गाकार खेत का क्षेत्रफल = 1764 मीटर2

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (भुजा)2

आयत का क्षेत्रफल = लंबाई × चौड़ाई

गणना:

एक वर्गाकार खेत का क्षेत्रफल = 1764 मीटर2

वर्गाकार खेत की भुजा = √1764 = 42 मीटर

आयत क्षेत्र की चौड़ाई = (42 × 1/6) = 7 मीटर

आयत क्षेत्र की लंबाई = (7 × 4) = 28 मीटर

आयताकार खेत का क्षेत्रफल = (28 × 7) मीटर2 = 196 मीटर2

पार्क को समतल करने की लागत = (196 × 30) रुपये 

⇒ 5880 रुपये 

इसलिए, पार्क को समतल करने की अभीष्ट लागत 5880 है

question: If 2x2 - 7x + 5 = 0, then what is the value of \(x^3+\frac{125}{8x^3}\) ?
question_hi: यदि 2x2 - 7x + 5 = 0, तो \(x^3+\frac{125}{8x^3}\) का मान क्या है?
solution:
Given:

2x2 – 7x + 5

Formula used:

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

2x2 – 7x + 5 = 0

⇒ 2x2 + 5 = 7x

⇒ x2 + 5/2 = 7/2

⇒ x + 5/2x = 7/2

Cube of both side of equation

⇒ (x + 5/2x)3 = (7/2)3

⇒ (x)3 + (5/2x)3 + 3 × x × 5/2x(x + 5/2x) = 343/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 + 15/2 (7/2) = 343/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 + 105/4 = 343/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = (343/8 – 105/4)

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = (343 – 210)/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = 133/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = \(16\frac{5}{8}\)

∴ The required value is \(16\frac{5}{8}\)

Shortcut Trick 2x2 - 7x + 5 = 0 ⇒ \(x + {5 \over2x}={7 \over 2}\)

if  \(x + {a \over bx}=G\) then \(x^3 + ({a \over bx})^3=G^3-3\times G\times {a \over b}\)

\(( {7 \over 2})^3 -3 \times {7 \over 2}\times {5 \over 2}\) 

\({7 \over 2}[( {7 \over 2})^2 -3 \times {5 \over 2}]\)

\({133 \over 8} = 16{5 \over 8}\)

question: Radha saves x% of her income. If her income increases by 28% and the expenditure increases by 20%, then her savings increase by 40%. What is the value of x ?
question_hi: राधा अपनी आय का x% बचाती है। यदि उसकी आय में 28% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में 40% की वृद्धि होती है। x का मान क्या है ?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Using the Alligation Method between Expenditure and Savings to find the ratio of Income components.

Expenditure increase (20%) and Savings increase (40%) result in a total Income increase (28%).

Ratio of Expenditure : Savings = (40 − 28) : (28 − 20) = 12 : 8 = 3 : 2.

Savings percentage (x) = [Savings / (Expenditure + Savings)] × 100 = [2 / (3 + 2)] × 100 = 40%.

∴ The correct answer is 40.

Alternate Method

Given: Savings = x% of Income, Income increase = 28%, Expenditure increase = 20%, Savings increase = 40%.

Formula Used: Income = Expenditure + Savings

⇒ Let Income be 100. Then Savings = x and Expenditure = 100 − x.

⇒ New Income = 100 × 1.28 = 128.

⇒ New Expenditure = (100 − x) × 1.20 = 120 − 1.2x.

⇒ New Savings = x × 1.40 = 1.4x.

⇒ New Income = New Expenditure + New Savings

⇒ 128 = (120 − 1.2x) + 1.4x

⇒ 128 − 120 = 0.2x

⇒ 8 = 0.2x

⇒ x = 8 / 0.2 = 40.

∴ The correct answer is 40.

Additional Information

Income-Expenditure Concept

The fundamental relation is Income = Expenditure + Savings. Any percentage change in components must balance this equation.

Alligation in Income Problems

When two parts of a whole change by different percentages, the overall percentage change is the weighted average. The Alligation rule helps find the initial ratio of those parts.

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective change is [a + b + (a×b)/100]%. This is useful for problems involving multiple increases/decreases.
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick

Income (आय) के घटकों का अनुपात ज्ञात करने के लिए Expenditure (व्यय) और Savings (बचत) के बीच Alligation Method का उपयोग करने पर।

Expenditure में वृद्धि (20%) और Savings में वृद्धि (40%) के परिणामस्वरूप कुल Income में वृद्धि (28%) होती है।

Expenditure : Savings का अनुपात = (40 − 28) : (28 − 20) = 12 : 8 = 3 : 2.

Savings प्रतिशत (x) = [Savings / (Expenditure + Savings)] × 100 = [2 / (3 + 2)] × 100 = 40%.

∴ सही उत्तर 40 है।

Alternate Method

दिया गया है: Savings = Income का x%, Income में वृद्धि = 28%, Expenditure में वृद्धि = 20%, Savings में वृद्धि = 40%.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र: Income = Expenditure + Savings

⇒ माना Income 100 है। तब Savings = x और Expenditure = 100 − x.

⇒ नई Income = 100 × 1.28 = 128.

⇒ नया Expenditure = (100 − x) × 1.20 = 120 − 1.2x.

⇒ नई Savings = x × 1.40 = 1.4x.

⇒ नई Income = नया Expenditure + नई Savings

⇒ 128 = (120 − 1.2x) + 1.4x

⇒ 128 − 120 = 0.2x

⇒ 8 = 0.2x

⇒ x = 8 / 0.2 = 40.

∴ सही उत्तर 40 है।

Additional Information

आय-व्यय की अवधारणा (Income-Expenditure Concept)

मूल संबंध Income = Expenditure + Savings है। घटकों में किसी भी प्रतिशत परिवर्तन को इस समीकरण को संतुलित करना चाहिए।

आय की समस्याओं में Alligation

जब एक पूर्ण राशि के दो भाग अलग-अलग प्रतिशत से बदलते हैं, तो कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन भारित औसत (weighted average) होता है। Alligation rule उन भागों के प्रारंभिक अनुपात को खोजने में मदद करता है।

क्रमिक प्रतिशत परिवर्तन (Successive Percentage Change)

a% और b% के दो क्रमिक परिवर्तनों के लिए, प्रभावी परिवर्तन [a + b + (axb)/100]% होता है। यह उन समस्याओं के लिए उपयोगी है जिनमें कई बार वृद्धि/कमी होती है।

question:

7 × 4 ÷ 21 का 4 - 5 ÷ 4 × (9 - 13) + 2 - 2 ÷ 8
solution:
Concept Used:      

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

Calculation:

7 × 4 ÷ 21 of 4 – 5 ÷ 4 × (9 –  13) + 2 – 2 ÷ 8

⇒ 7 × 4 ÷ 21 of 4 – 5 ÷ 4 × (-4) + 2 – 2 ÷ 8

⇒ 7/21 + 20/4 + 2 - 1/4

⇒ 1/3 + 5 + 2 – 1/4

⇒ 1/3 + 7 – 1/4

⇒ (4 + 84 – 3)/12

⇒ (88 – 3)/12

⇒ 85/12

⇒ \(7\frac{1}{12}\)

∴ The required value is \(7\frac{1}{12}\)

⇒ 85/12

⇒ \(7\frac{1}{12}\)

∴ अभीष्ट मान \(7\frac{1}{12}\) है ​

question: If sin2 θ - cos2 θ - 3 sin θ + 2 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then what is the value of \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{\sec\theta-\tan\theta}}\) is:
question_hi: यदि sin2 θ - cos2 θ - 3 sin θ + 2 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, तो \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{\sec\theta-\tan\theta}}\)का मान क्या है:
solution:
Given:

sin2 θ - cos2 θ - 3 sin θ + 2 = 0

Formula used:

cos2θ = 1 – sin2θ 

sec30° = 2/√3

tan30° = 1/√3

(sec2θ – tan2θ) = 1

Calculation:

sin2 θ – cos2 θ – 3 sin θ + 2 = 0

⇒ sin2θ – (1 – sin2θ) – 3sinθ + 2 = 0

⇒ sin2θ – 1 + sin2θ – 3sinθ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2sin2θ – 3sinθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 2sin2θ – 2sinθ – sinθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ(sinθ – 1) – 1(sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ (2sinθ – 1) (sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ sinθ = 1/2, 1

⇒ sinθ = 1/2 = 30° [sin 90° = 1, we cannot take the value of 90°]

Now,

\(\frac{1}{√{\secθ-\tanθ}}\)

Multiplying with the conjugate of √secθ + tanθ 

⇒ 1/√secθ – tanθ × (√secθ + tanθ/√secθ + tanθ)

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/(sec2θ – tan2θ)

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/1

Now, put the value of θ = 30° 

⇒ √sec30° + tan30° 

⇒ √(2/√3 + 1/√3)

⇒ √(3/√3)

⇒ \(\sqrt[4]{3}\)

So, the required value is \(\sqrt[4]{3}\)

Shortcut Trick Put θ = 30° 

⇒ sin230° - cos230° - 3 sin30° + 2

⇒ (1/4) - (3/4) - (3/2) + 2

⇒ (-1/2) - (3/2) + 2

⇒ - 2 + 2 = 0

Now,

\(\frac{1}{√{\secθ-\tanθ}}\)

Multiplying with the conjugate of √secθ + tanθ 

⇒ 1/√secθ – tanθ × (√secθ + tanθ/√secθ + tanθ)

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/(sec2θ – tan2θ)

question: Vertices A, B,C and D of a quadrilateral ABCD lie on a circle. ∠A is three times ∠C and ∠D is two times ∠B. What is the difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C?

solution:
Given:

Vertices A, B,C and D of a quadrilateral ABCD lie on a circle

Concept used:

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle is 180°.

Calculation:

⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 4θ = 180° 

⇒ θ = 45° 

⇒ ∠C = 45° 

Again,

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180° 

⇒ α + 2α = 180° 

⇒ 3α = 180° 

⇒ α = 60° 

⇒ ∠B = 60° 

The value of ∠D = 2α = (2 × 60) = 120° 

The difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C = (120° – 45°)

⇒ 75° 

∴ The required difference is 75° 

Shortcut Trick ⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180° 

⇒ 3θ + θ = 180° 

⇒ θ = 45° 

⇒ ∠C = 45° 

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180°

⇒ α = 60° 

⇒ ∠B = 60° 

The difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C = (120° – 45°)

⇒ 75°

question: In an examination, the average score of a student was 67.6. If he would have got 27 more marks in Mathematics, 10 more marks in Computer Science, 18 more marks in History and retained the same marks in other subjects, then his average score would have been 72.6. How many papers were there in the examination?
question_hi: एक परीक्षा में, एक छात्र के औसत अंक 67.6 थे। यदि उसे गणित में 27 अंक अधिक, कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में 10 अंक अधिक, इतिहास में 18 अधिक अंक और अन्य विषयों में इसी तरह समान अंक प्राप्त होते, तो उसके औसत अंक 72.6 होते। परीक्षा में कितने प्रश्नपत्र हो सकते हैं?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Increase in Total Marks = 27 + 10 + 18 = 55

Increase in Average Score = 72.6 − 67.6 = 5

Number of papers = Total Marks Increase ÷ Average Increase

Number of papers = 55 ÷ 5 = 11

∴ The correct answer is 11.

Alternate Method

Given: Initial average = 67.6, Final average = 72.6, Mathematics increase = 27, Computer Science increase = 10, History increase = 18.

Formula Used: Total Marks = Average × Number of Papers

⇒ Let the total number of papers be n.

⇒ Total initial marks = 67.6 × n

⇒ Total marks added = 27 + 10 + 18 = 55

⇒ New total marks = 67.6n + 55

⇒ New average = (67.6n + 55) ÷ n = 72.6

⇒ 67.6n + 55 = 72.6n

⇒ 72.6n − 67.6n = 55

⇒ 5n = 55

⇒ n = 11

∴ The correct answer is 11.

Additional Information

Definition of Average

Average (Mean) is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Formula: Avg = Σx ÷ n.

Effect of Constant Addition

If every observation in a set is increased by a constant value k, the new average also increases by k.

Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all observations from their mean is always zero. This concept is useful in finding missing values or balancing averages.
solution_hi:

कुल अंकों में वृद्धि = 27 + 10 + 18 = 55

औसत स्कोर में वृद्धि = 72.6 − 67.6 = 5

प्रश्नपत्रों की संख्या = कुल अंकों में वृद्धि ÷ औसत वृद्धि

प्रश्नपत्रों की संख्या = 55 ÷ 5 = 11

∴ सही उत्तर 11 है।

Alternate Method

प्रयुक्त सूत्र: कुल अंक = औसत × प्रश्नपत्रों की संख्या

⇒ माना कि प्रश्नपत्रों की कुल संख्या n है।

⇒ कुल प्रारंभिक अंक = 67.6 × n

⇒ जोड़े गए कुल अंक = 27 + 10 + 18 = 55

⇒ नए कुल अंक = 67.6n + 55

⇒ नया औसत = (67.6n + 55) ÷ n = 72.6

⇒ 67.6n + 55 = 72.6n

⇒ 72.6n − 67.6n = 55

⇒ 5n = 55

⇒ n = 11

∴ सही उत्तर 11 है।

Additional Information

औसत की परिभाषा

औसत (माध्य) सभी प्रेक्षणों का योग है जिसे प्रेक्षणों की कुल संख्या से विभाजित किया जाता है। सूत्र: Avg = Σx ÷ n.

यदि एक सेट में प्रत्येक प्रेक्षण को एक नियत मान k से बढ़ा दिया जाता है, तो नया औसत भी k से बढ़ जाता है।

question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 hours and 16 hours respectively and pipe C can empty the full tank in 24 hours. All three pipes are opened together, but after 4 hours pipe B is closed. In how many hours, the empty tank will be completely filled?
question_hi: पाइप A और B एक टैंक को क्रमशः 12 घंटे और 16 घंटे में भर सकते हैं और पाइप C पूरे टैंक को 24 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। तीनों पाइपों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाता है, लेकिन 4 घंटे बाद पाइप B को बंद कर दिया जाता है। खाली टंकी कितने घंटे में पूरी तरह भर जाएगी?
solution:
Given:

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe A = 12 hours

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe B = 16 hours

Time taken to empty a tank by Pipe C = 24 hours

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

LCM of 12, 16 and 24 is 48

Efficiency of A to fill the tank = (48/12) = 4 hours/day

Efficiency of B to fill the tank = (48/16) = 3 hours/day

Efficiency of C to empty the tank = (48/24) = - 2 hours/day

All three pipes opened together for 4 hours = [(4 + 3 – 2) × 4]

⇒ (5 × 4) = 20 unit

Remaining unit = (48 – 20) = 28 unit

Time taken by A and C together = [28/(4 – 2)]

⇒ (28/2) = 14 hours

Now,

Total time is taken to fill the empty tank = (14 + 4) hours

⇒ 18 hours

∴ The required time is 18 hours

Shortcut Trick

Effective efficiency = 5

In 4 hours all three pipes will fill 5 × 4 = 20 units

Now, Remaining 48 - 20 = 28 units will be filled by A and C

So, Total efficiency of A and C = 2

So, time = 28/2 = 14 hours

Total time = 14 + 4 = 18 hours

पाइप C द्वारा एक टैंक को खाली करने में लिया गया समय = 24 घंटे

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

कार्य = दक्षता × समय

गणना:

टैंक को खाली करने के लिए C की दक्षता = (48/24) = - 2 घंटे/दिन

सभी तीन पाइप एक साथ 4 घंटे के लिए खोले गए = [(4 + 3 - 2) × 4]

⇒ (5 × 4) = 20 इकाई

शेष इकाई = (48 - 20) = 28 

A और C द्वारा एक साथ लिया गया समय = [28/(4 – 2)]

⇒ (28/2) = 14 घंटे

अब,

खाली टंकी को भरने में लिया गया कुल समय = (14 + 4) घंटे

⇒ 18 घंटे

∴ अभीष्ट समय 18 घंटे है

question: A circle is inscribed in a quadrilateral ABCD, touching sides AB, BC CD and DA at P, Q, R and S, respectively. If AS = 6 cm, BC = 12 cm, and CR = 5 cm, then the length of AB (in cm) is:
question_hi: एक चतुर्भुज ABCD में एक वृत्त अन्तर्निहित है, जो भुजाओं AB, BC, CD और DA को क्रमशः P, Q, R और S पर स्पर्श करता है। यदि AS = 6 सेमी, BC = 12 सेमी, और CR = 5 सेमी, तो AB की लंबाई (सेमी में) है:
solution:
Given:

BC = 12 cm

CR = 5 cm

Concept used:

If from one external point, two tangents are drawn to a circle then they have equal tangent segments.

Calculation:

⇒ (12 – 5) = 7 cm

AS = AP = 6 cm ....(2)

Adding equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ (7 + 6)

⇒ 13 cm

So, the length of AB is 13 cm

question: If the 5 - digit number 593ab is divisible by 3, 7 and 11, then what is the value of (a<sup>2</sup> - b<sup>2</sup> + ab)?
question_hi: यदि 5 अंकों की संख्या 593ab, 3, 7 और 11 से विभाज्य है, तो (a2 - b2 + ab) का मान क्या होगा?
solution:
Given:

The five-digit number = 593ab

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of 3 - A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

Divisibility rule of 7 - If a number is divisible by 7, then the difference between twice the unit digit of the given number and the remaining part of the given number should be a multiple of 7 or it should be equal to 0

Divisibility rule of 11 - If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equals 0 or is divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

Calculation:

LCM of 3, 7, 11 is 231

Let's assume the largest number is 59399.

Now, on dividing 59399 by 231

We get approx 257.13

So, the actual number = 231 × 257 = 59367

So, a = 6 and b = 7

Now,

The value of (a2 – b2 + ab) = (6)2 – (7)2 + (6 × 7)

⇒ (36 – 49 + 42)

⇒ (78 – 49)

⇒ 29

∴ The required value is 29

Alternate Method The given number is 593ab

We know that, 3, 7, and 11 divide 593ab 

Hence getting the nearest 5-digit number having first 3 digits as 593

⇒ 50820 + 4620 + 4620 = 60060

subtracting 462 from 60060, 

⇒ 60060 - 462 = 59,598

subtracting 231 from 59,598

⇒ 59367

Hence a = 6 and b = 7

The value of (a2 – b2 + ab) = (6)2 – (7)2 + (6 × 7)

⇒ (36 – 49 + 42)

⇒ (78 – 49)

⇒ 29

question: A sum of Rs. 25600 is invested on simple interest partly at 7% per annum and the remaining at 9% per annum. The total interest at the end of 3 years is Rs. 5832. How much money (in Rs.) was invested at 9% per annum?
question_hi: 25600 रुपये की राशि साधारण ब्याज पर आंशिक रूप से 7% प्रति वर्ष और शेष 9% प्रति वर्ष की दर से निवेश की जाती है। 3 वर्ष के अंत में कुल ब्याज 5832 रुपये है। 9% प्रति वर्ष की दर से कितना पैसा (रुपये में) निवेश किया गया था?
solution:
Shortcut Trick 

Interest for one year = 5832/3 = Rs. 1944

Interest for 7% = 25600 × 7/100 = 1792

Interest for 9% = 25600 × 9/100 = 2304

The sum invested on 9%

= 152/(360 + 152) × 25600

= 152/512 × 25600 = Rs. 7600

 Alternate Method

Given:

Sum = Rs. 25600

R1 = 7%

R2 = 9%

The total interest at the end of 3 years = Rs. 5832

Formula used:

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Calculation:

Let the principal be x

Then,

A sum of Rs. 25600 is invested on SI at (25600 – x)

The total interest at the end of 3 years = Rs. 5832

The total interest at the end of 1 year = Rs. (5832/3)

⇒ Rs. 1944

Now,

According to the question

⇒ (x × 1 × 9)/100 + [(25600 – x) × 1 × 7]/100 = 1944

⇒ 9x/100 + (179200 – 7x)/100 = 1944

⇒ 9x + 179200 – 7x = 194400

⇒ (9x – 7x) = (194400 – 179200)

⇒ 2x = 15200

⇒ x = (15200/2)

⇒ x = 7600

∴ The money invested at 9% per annum is Rs. 7600
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick 

एक वर्ष का ब्याज = 5832/3 = रु. 1944

7% ब्याज = 25600 × 7/100 = 1792

9% ब्याज = 25600 × 9/100 = 2304

9% पर निवेश की गई राशि:

= 152/(360 + 152) × 25600

⇒ (9x – 7x) = (194400 – 179200)

question: A fruit merchant bought some bananas. One fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away. He sold two-fifth of the remaining bananas with him at 15% profit and the rest remaining bananas at 10% profit. Find his overall loss or profit percent?
question_hi: एक फल व्यापारी ने कुछ केले खरीदे। उनमें से पांचवां हिस्सा सड़ गया और फेंक दिया गया। उसने अपने पास बचे केले के दो-पांचवें हिस्से को 15% लाभ पर और शेष केले को 10% लाभ पर बेच दिया। उसकी कुल हानि या लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए?
solution:
Shortcut Trick Let 100% bananas cost to Rs. 100.

Remaining bananas = 80%

80% bananas cost Rs. 80.

Total profit percentage on them = 2/5 × 15 + 3/5 × 10 = 12%

SP of bananas = 80 × 112/100 = 89.6

Loss = 100 - 89.6 = 10.4

Loss% = (10.4/100) × 100 = 10.4%

Alternate Method

Given:

One-fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away.

He sold two-fifth of the remaining bananas with him at a 15% profit 

The remaining bananas at 10% profit. 

Formula used:

Loss = SP – CP

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

Calculation:

Let fruit merchant bought 100 bananas

One fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away = (1/5 of 100)

⇒ (1/5 × 100)

⇒ 20

Now,

He sold two fifth of the bananas with him at 15% profit = (2/5 of 80)

⇒ (2/5 × 80)

⇒ 32 

The remaining bananas at 10% profit = [100 – (20 + 32)]

⇒ (100 – 52) = 48

Now,

Let the CP of each banana be x

Then, CP of 100 banana be 100x

Now,

Total SP = 20x × 0 + 32x(1 + 15/100) + 48x(1 + 10/100)

⇒  0 + 32x(115/100) + 48x(110/100)

⇒ 0 + 32x(23/20) + 48x(11x/10)

⇒ 0 + 184x/5 + 264x/5

⇒ 448x/5

⇒ 89.6x

Loss = (SP – CP)

⇒ (100x – 89.6x)

⇒ 10.4x

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

⇒ (10.4x/100x × 100)

⇒ 10.4

∴ The required Loss% is 10.4%
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick माना 100% केले की कीमत 100 रुपये है।

शेष केले = 80%

80% केले की कीमत 80 रुपये है।

उन पर कुल लाभ प्रतिशत = 2/5 × 15 + 3/5 × 10 = 12%

केले का विक्रय मूल्य = 80 × 112/100 = 89.6

हानि = 100 - 89.6 = 10.4

हानि% = (10.4/100) × 100 = 10.4%

Alternate Method

दिया गया है:

उनमें से पांचवां हिस्सा सड़ गया और फेंक दिया गया।

उसने अपने पास बचे केले के दो-पांचवें हिस्से को 15% लाभ पर बेच दिया

शेष केले 10% लाभ पर है।

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

हानि = विक्रय मूल्य - क्रय मूल्य 

हानि% = हानि/क्रय मूल्य × 100

गणना:

मान लीजिए फल व्यापारी ने 100 केले खरीदे।

उनमें से पांचवां हिस्सा सड़ गया और फेंक दिया गया = (100 का 1/5)

⇒ (1/5 × 100)

⇒ 20

अब,

उसने अपने पास बचे केले के दो-पांचवें हिस्से को 15% लाभ पर बेच दिया = (80 का 2/5)

⇒ (2/5 × 80)

⇒ 32 

शेष केले 10% लाभ पर है = [100 - (20 + 32)]

⇒ (100 – 52) = 48

अब,

माना प्रत्येक केले का क्रय मूल्य x है।

तो, 100 केले का क्रय मूल्य 100x होगा।

अब,

कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 20x × 0 + 32x (1 + 15/100) + 48x (1 + 10/100)

⇒  0 + 32x(115/100) + 48x(110/100)

⇒ 0 + 32x(23/20) + 48x(11x/10)

⇒ 0 + 184x/5 + 264x/5

⇒ 448x/5

⇒ 89.6x

हानि = (विक्रय मूल्य - क्रय मूल्य)

⇒ (100x – 89.6x)

⇒ 10.4x

हानि% = हानि/क्रय मूल्य × 100

⇒ (10.4x/100x × 100)

⇒ 10.4

∴ अभीष्ट हानि% 10.4% है।

question: In festival season, a shopkeeper allows a discount of 10% on every item. Even after giving the discount, he makes a profit of 20%. If he does not give any discount, then what will be his profit percent? (correct to 2 decimal places)
question_hi: त्योहारों के मौसम में एक दुकानदार प्रत्येक वस्तु पर 10% की छूट देता है। छूट देने के बाद भी उसे 20% का लाभ होता है। यदि वह कोई छूट नहीं देता है, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा? (दो दशमलव स्थान तक)
solution:
Given:

Discount = 10%

Profit = 20%

Formula used:

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

Calculation:

Let the marked price be MP 

Let the cost price be CP

According to the question

⇒ (90% of MP) = (120% of CP)

⇒ (90/100 × MP) = (120/100 × CP)

⇒ (9/10 × MP) = (6/5 × CP)

MP/CP = 4/3

Profit = (4 – 3) = 1

Profit% = (1/3 × 100)

⇒ (100/3)%

⇒ 33.33%

∴ The required profit% is 33.33
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

छूट = 10%

लाभ = 20%

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

लाभ = विक्रय मूल्य - क्रय मूल्य 

लाभ% = लाभ/क्रय मूल्य × 100

गणना:

माना अंकित मूल्य MP है

माना क्रय मूल्य CP

प्रश्न के अनुसार

⇒ (MP का 90%) = (CP का 120%)

⇒ (90/100 × MP) = (120/100 × CP)

⇒ (9/10 × MP) = (6/5 × CP)

MP/CP = 4/3

लाभ = (4 - 3) = 1

लाभ% = (1/3 × 100)

⇒ (100/3)%

⇒ 33.33%

∴ अभीष्ट लाभ% 33.33 है

question: In triangle ABC, AD is the bisector of ∠A. If AB = 5 cm, AC = 7.5 cm and BC = 10 cm, then what is the distance of D from the mid-point of BC (in cm)?
question_hi: त्रिभुज ABC में AD, A का समद्विभाजक है। यदि AB = 5 सेमी, AC = 7.5 सेमी और BC = 10 सेमी, तो BC के मध्य-बिंदु से D की दूरी (सेमी में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:

AB = 5 cm

AC = 7.5 cm

BC = 10 cm

Concept used:

Angle bisector theorem:  The angle bisector of a triangle bisects the opposite side in such a way that the ratio of the two-line segments is proportional to the ratio of the other two sides.

Midpoint theorem: The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of two sides of the triangle is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

Calculation:

AD is the bisector of ∠A

⇒ AB/AC = BD/DC  [By angle bisector theorem]

⇒ 5/7.5 = BD/DC

⇒ 2/3 = BD/DC

3/2 = DC/BD

Adding 1 to both sides, we get:

\(\frac{3}{2}\) + 1 = \(\frac{DC}{BD}\) + 1

\(\frac{5}{2}\) = \(\frac{BD+DC}{BD}\) = \(\frac{BC}{BD}\)

Since BC = 10, we get:

The value of BD = (2/5 × 10) = 4

The value of DC = (3/5 × 10) = 6

According to the question

Midpoint of BC = (10/2) = 5

So, We take, M as a midpoint on BC = 5

Now,

The distance between D and M = (6 – 5) = 1

So, the required value is 1 cm
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

AB = 5 सेमी

AC = 7.5 सेमी

BC = 10 सेमी

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

कोण समद्विभाजक प्रमेय: त्रिभुज का कोण समद्विभाजक विपरीत भुजा को इस प्रकार समद्विभाजित करता है कि दोनों रेखाखंडों का अनुपात अन्य दो भुजाओं के अनुपात के समानुपाती हो।

मध्यबिंदु प्रमेय: त्रिभुज की दो भुजाओं के मध्यबिंदु को मिलाने वाला रेखाखंड उसकी तीसरी भुजा के समानांतर और तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई का आधा भी होता है।

गणना:

AD, ∠A का समद्विभाजक है  

⇒ AB/AC = BD/DC   [कोण द्विभाजक प्रमेय द्वारा]

⇒ 5/7.5 = BD/DC

⇒ 2/3 = BD/DC

3/2 = DC/BD

दोनों पक्षों में 1 जोड़ने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं:

\(\frac{3}{2}+1=\frac{DC}{BD}+1\)

\(\frac{5}{2}=\frac{BD+DC}{BD}=\frac{BC}{BD}\)

चूँकि BC = 10, हमें प्राप्त होता हैं:

BD का मान = (2/5 × 10) = 4

DC का मान = (3/5 × 10) = 6

प्रश्नानुसार,

BC का मध्यबिंदु = (10/2) = 5

इसलिए, हम M को BC पर एक मध्यबिंदु के रूप में लेते हैं = 5 

अब,

D और M के बीच की दूरी = (6 - 5) = 1

question: A boat covers a round trip journey between two points A and B in a river in T hours. If its speed in still water becomes 2 times, it would take \(\frac{80}{161}\) T hours for the same journey. Find the ratio of its speed in still water to the speed of the river.
question_hi: एक नाव नदी में दो बिंदुओं A और B के बीच की राउंड ट्रिप को T घंटे में पूरा करती है। यदि शांत जल में इसकी गति 2 गुनी हो जाती है, तो वह उसी ट्रिप में \(\frac{80}{161}\) T घंटे का समय लेती है। शांत जल में इसकी गति का नदी की गति से अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution:
Given: 

A boat covers a round trip journey between two points A and B in a river in T hours

Formula used:

Downstream = (u + v) km/hr

Upstream = (u – v) km/hr

Calculation:

Let the speed of boat in still water be xkm/hr

Speed of stream = y km/hr

Let the distance between them be d 

Downstream = (x + y) km/hr

Upstream = (x – y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ d/(x + y) + d/(x – y) = 161T

⇒ d(x - y + x + y)/ x2 - y2 = 161T

⇒d(2x)/161(x2 - y2) = T   ......... (1)

Again,

⇒ d/(2x + y) + d/(2x – y) = 80T

⇒d(2x - y + 2x + y)/(2x)2 - (y)2 = 80T

⇒d(4x) / 80(4x2 - y2) = T  ..........(2)

Now equalling both the equations,

⇒d(2x)/161(x2 - y2) = d(4x) / 80(4x2 - y2) 

⇒1/161(x2 - y2) = 2/ 80(4x2 - y2) 

⇒1/(161x2 - 161y2) = 1/(160x2 - 40y2)

⇒160x2 - 40y2 = 161x2 - 161y2

⇒x2 = 121y2

⇒x/y = 11/1

∴ The required ratio is 11 : 1

Alternate Method 

Let the speed of boat in still water be xkm/hr

Speed of stream = y km/hr

Let the distance between them be d 

Downstream = (x + y) km/hr

Upstream = (x – y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ d/(x + y) + d/(x – y) = T

⇒ d(1/x + y) + (1/x – y) = T

⇒ d[(x – y) + (x + y)/(x2 – y2)] = T

⇒ d[(2x/(x2 – y2) = T

⇒ d/T = x2 – y2/2x .....(1)

Again,

⇒ d/(2x + y) + d/(2x – y) = 80T/161

⇒ d(1/2x + y + 1/2x – y) = 80T/161

⇒ d(2x – y+ 2x + y)/4x2 – y2 = 80T/161

⇒ d(4x/4x2 – y2) = 80T/161

⇒ d/T = 80(4x2 – y2)/4x × 161 ......(2)

Now, substituting both the equation, we get

d/T = x2 – y2/2x =  80(4x2 – y2)/4x × 161

⇒ x2 – y2 = 40(4x2 – y2)/161

⇒ (161x2 – 161y2) = (160x2 – 40y2)

⇒ (161x2 – 160x2) = (161y2 – 40y2)

⇒ x2 = 121y2

⇒ x/y = 11/1

∴ The required ratio is 11 : 1

Hint

In this type of question, always try to make two equations equal to the same variable so that we can equalize the two equations.
